description.p: MD++ is a free, lightweight Markdown editor in the spirit of Notepad++: it opens instantly, never loses unsaved text, and understands Markdown as you type.

ul.li: Completion for headings, files, references, emoji and code-block languages
Diagnostics for broken links, missing headings and uneven tables
Live preview with scroll sync, outline, folder panel and find in files
Table, list and formatting assists, rename heading, code actions and snippets
Hot exit: quit any time, everything comes back
